system: Kev Device Memory Benchmark & Lifecycle Analysis

comparison_vs_laya.download_reduction: 46.2% smaller initial download than Laya multilingual bundle
comparison_vs_laya.batching_advantage: Kev packs state + all questions into single sequence (e.g. 132 tokens for 4 questions). Forward pass is evaluated once. Laya requires sequential evaluations per question plus separate act-head pass.
comparison_vs_laya.memory_retention: KevSession.delete() releases ORT session and Wasm linear memory buffers, restoring JS heap to baseline levels.
